name: Hotdog's Alien Themed Weapon Mods
teaser: Adds retextures of the three Hera Arms CQR products with Weyland-Yutani Corp. logos!
description_html:
This mod (as of writing) includes three new items. The items added are all retextures of previously existing items.

What’s new?

  1. Hera Arms CQR AK stock with a Russian Weyland-Yutani Corp. logo
  2. Hera Arms CQR AR stock with a Weyland-Yutani Corp. logo
  3. Hera Arms CQR foregrip with a Weyland-Yutani Corp. logo

Images

Installation

  1. Click “Download”
  2. Open the zipped file
  3. Open “Weyland-Yutani-Corp.-Weapon-mods-(version number)”
  4. Drag the “user” folder into your SPT directory

KNOWN ISSUES

The textures on the right-facing sides of both stocks are cut off due to how BSG created them. I can fix this, but it’s difficult, and I’d rather not spend time fixing the side you’ll see less.
